sourceRefs.locator: Word analysis of atta, unsar and himinam on fol. 4v (facsimile 8); weihnai begins the next petition on fol. 5r (facsimile 9).
John 12:38, fol. 78r (facsimile 99). The tokens hauseinai and unsarai give the second possessive example in its inflected form.
Chapter 1, discussion immediately before §1.5 and §1.5 on the division of translation work and the codices; §2.1, table 2.1, on letter shapes, order and numeral values.

note.de: Die Form atta unsar auf Blatt 4v und unsarai auf Blatt 78r sind zwei Beispiele aus derselben Handschrift.
note.en: The sequence atta unsar on folio 4v and unsarai on folio 78r provide examples from the same manuscript.
